entities.name: Mana Rig
entities.description: A Thran complex on Shiv in Dominaria that produced powerstones and Thran metal.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Dominarian continent with a brutal desert.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Found the Mana Rig and got goblins and viashino to operate it.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: In charge of the Mana Rig, who installed its counterattack feature and triggered its self-destruction.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian whose minions attacked the Rig.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Phased out the Rig's main part with Zhalfir.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Her Phyrexians overran the Rig in the Second Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: New Coalition
entities.description: Used the Rig as a base of operations.

entities.name: Gavon Deniz
entities.description: Attempted to seize control of the Rig, failed, and disappeared.

entities.name: Shivan Council
entities.description: Deemed the Rig too powerful for anyone to use.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which the Rig was attacked.

entities.name: Battle of the Mana Rig
entities.description: Largest battle of the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria.

events.summary: Urza finds the Mana Rig during Urza's Legacy; his entry nearly sparks a war with the Shivans, but he gets goblins and viashino to operate it.
events.quote: He managed to get the Goblins and Viashino to work together to operate the Rig

events.summary: Phyrexian forces attack the Mana Rig; it counterattacks with a mobile segment shooting lava, installed by Jhoira.
events.quote: launched a counterattack by deploying a detachable and mobile segment of itself

events.summary: Teferi phases the main part of the Rig, with Jhoira and part of Shiv, out with Zhalfir.
events.quote: was phased out by Teferi along with Zhalfir

events.summary: Sheoldred's Phyrexians overrun the Rig and Jhoira triggers its self-destruction; Phyrexia achieves its aims but with heavy losses.
events.quote: Jhoira triggered the Mana Rig to self-destruct

events.summary: Around 4560 AR the Shivan Council leaves the Rig idle; Gavon Deniz fails to seize control and disappears with the Power Stone.
events.quote: Gavon Deniz attempted to seize control, failed, and disappeared

relations.quote: The Mana Rig was a complex of structures built by the Thran
a feature installed by Jhoira who had been in charge of the complex
